purpose: Pack sources into a portable Kain capsule (.kn file)
notes: Alias: kain a; packs any number of modules (2-2594) into a single file

purpose: Inspect capsule metadata + public interface + file inventory
notes: No unpacking needed; shows name, version, digest, file count, module count

purpose: Extract all files from capsule into directory tree
notes: Default output: <capsule>.unpacked/; companion capsules auto-merge

purpose: Self-describing Kain source file embedding file archive
notes: Valid Kain source; passes kain check; comment sentinels hide metadata

purpose: Each file as discrete //!kain-file block with inline content
notes: Human-readable in editor; git diff-able; binary files base64-encoded

purpose: Single //!kain-capsule-payload block with zstd-compressed base64 JSON
notes: Max compression; payload digest verified on every read; must unpack to inspect

purpose: Plain concatenated .kn files with comment separators, no sentinel markers
notes: No //!kain-file sentinels; fully grep-able; for cross-ecosystem interop

purpose: TOML-encoded metadata behind comment sentinels
notes: Schema version, kind, storage, content policy, digest, timestamp, authors, tags

purpose: Include .kn, .c, .h, config files, markdown (excludes artifacts/assets/evidence)
notes: Default content policy; distributable source package

purpose: Everything — raw directory snapshot
notes: Complete archival backup

purpose: Images, fonts, audio, video, 3D models, ZIPs, PDFs, non-UTF-8 binaries
notes: Game asset bundles, design files

purpose: .exe, .dll, .so, .lib, .obj, .wasm, .spv, .ptx, .pdb, .runtime_contract.json
notes: Compile output distribution, CI build artifacts

purpose: Telemetry, benchmark reports, attrition results, proof attestations, certify gates
notes: Reproducible evidence for audits

purpose: Source companion capsule — the primary distributable capsule
notes: Contains source code; stands alone for code reuse

purpose: Artifacts companion capsule (.exe/.dll/.spv outputs)
notes: Discovered by capsule_set name; merged on materialize

purpose: Evidence companion capsule (telemetry + proof results)
notes: Discovered by capsule_set name; merged on materialize

purpose: Sibling capsule set name for companion discovery
notes: Allows source+artifacts+evidence to travel together; auto-merge on unpack

syntax: capsule .kn file -> read metadata -> discover companions -> state hash -> check cache -> unpack -> resolve imports
purpose: Import path from capsule file to compiler module resolution
notes: Content-addressed cache at .kain/cache/amalgamate/<state-hash>/; state hash includes all companion digests

purpose: Create distributable capsule(s) for a project
notes: Default output: .kain/publish/<name>-<version>.kn

purpose: Record capsule-backed dependency in KAIN.lock
notes: Package can be name, local path, or capsule .kn file path

purpose: Install package into ~/.kain/packages/<name>/<version>/
notes: Stores source.kn + artifacts.kn + evidence.kn + workspace/ directory

purpose: Pins exact capsule digests with [[packages]] entries
notes: schema = 1; no version range resolution; digest IS the truth

purpose: Wired into build.kn as a build task
notes: Runs after its dependencies; respects build graph DAG ordering

purpose: Metadata flags for capsule packaging
notes: All repeatable except name/version

purpose: Header rendering mode in capsule file
notes: rich: full preview directory; minimal: basic info; off: no header

purpose: Archive payload compression (archive mode only)
notes: Default: zstd; level 19 compression

purpose: Public API symbol index in header
notes: auto: scans and lists pub symbols; off: skip

purpose: Max preview symbols shown in header (default 40)
notes: Limits header size for large capsules

purpose: Start of metadata section / header
notes: Followed by TOML metadata

purpose: End of metadata section
notes: Closes metadata block

purpose: Start of editable file metadata block
notes: Contains path, kind, encoding, bytes, sha256

purpose: Content separation marker within a file block
notes: Actual file content follows

purpose: End of editable file block
notes: Closes file block

purpose: Start of archive payload (base64)
notes: Used in archive mode

purpose: End of archive payload
notes: Closes archive payload block

purpose: Battle-tested at extreme scale
notes: 316,135 lines packed; 3,211+ public symbols; typecheck: 0 errors

purpose: Content-addressed materialization cache
notes: State hash includes primary capsule path + digest + all companion digests

purpose: Package installation directory
notes: Contains source.kn, artifacts.kn, evidence.kn, workspace/

purpose: All capsule-relative paths use / regardless of platform
notes: src/main.kn works on Windows, Linux, macOS
